auth.login.sub.en: For Pulsar staff and partner producers.
auth.login.sub.zh: 供 Pulsar 员工与合作制片方使用。

auth.password.hint.en: No password yet? Enter your email and use the sign-in link instead.
auth.password.hint.zh: 还没有密码？填写邮箱后使用登录链接进入。

auth.magic.sent.en: Check your inbox. The link signs you in.
auth.magic.sent.zh: 请查收邮件，点击链接即可登录。

auth.err.noProfile.en: This account has no Studio profile yet. Ask Pulsar to add you.
auth.err.noProfile.zh: 该账号尚未开通 Studio 权限，请联系 Pulsar 开通。

auth.err.callback.en: That sign-in link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
auth.err.callback.zh: 登录链接无效或已过期，请重新获取。

auth.dev.sub.en: Local preview with no database. Choose who to enter as.
auth.dev.sub.zh: 本地预览，未连接数据库。请选择进入身份。

auth.dev.staff.zh: 以 Pulsar 员工身份进入
